name: Air band (VHF voice)
licence_note: Reception only; transmitting needs an aeronautical licence.
note: 118.000-136.975 MHz. Stepping follows the channel raster: 25 kHz everywhere, 8.33 kHz in European airspace (three channels per 25 kHz, named like 118.005, 118.010, 118.015). Voice is AM.
source: ICAO Annex 10 Vol. V (118-137 MHz, 25 kHz and 8.33 kHz channel spacing); Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 1079/2012
